Compound Interest

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦Personal Finance

Calculate how your money grows over time with compound interest.

Formula:
A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
Variables:
  • AFuture value of investment/loan
  • PPrincipal investment amount
  • rAnnual interest rate (decimal)
  • nNumber of times interest compounds per year
  • tTime in years
Use Calculator→
🏦

Loan Payment (Amortization)

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦Personal Finance

Calculate monthly loan payments for any type of loan.

Formula:
PMT = P × [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]
Variables:
  • PMTMonthly payment
  • PPrincipal loan amount
  • rMonthly interest rate (annual rate ÷ 12)
  • nTotal number of payments
Use Calculator→

Return on Investment (ROI)

📈Investment

Measure profitability of an investment relative to its cost.

Formula:
ROI = [(Gain - Cost) ÷ Cost] × 100%
Variables:
  • ROIReturn on Investment percentage
  • GainReturn from investment
  • CostCost of investment
Use Calculator→

Net Present Value (NPV)

📈Investment

Determine present value of future cash flows.

Formula:
NPV = Σ [CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)^t] - Initial Investment
Variables:
  • NPVNet Present Value
  • CFₜCash flow at time t
  • rDiscount rate
  • tTime period
Use Calculator→

Break-even Point

💼Business

Find sales volume needed to cover all costs.

Formula:
Break-even Units = Fixed Costs ÷ (Price - Variable Cost)
Variables:
  • Fixed CostsCosts that dont change with production
  • PriceSelling price per unit
  • Variable CostCost per unit produced

Profit Margin

💼Business

Calculate profitability as percentage of revenue.

Formula:
Profit Margin = (Net Profit ÷ Revenue) × 100%
Variables:
  • Net ProfitRevenue minus all expenses
  • RevenueTotal sales income

Calculate monthly mortgage payments.

Calculate future value of regular deposits.

Weighted Average Cost of Capital

📈Investment

Calculate average cost of capital.

Formula:
WACC = (E/V × Re) + (D/V × Rd × (1 - Tc))
Variables:
  • EMarket value of equity
  • VTotal market value
  • ReCost of equity
  • DMarket value of debt
  • RdCost of debt
  • TcCorporate tax rate

Millionaire Calculator

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦Personal Finance

Calculate how long it takes to become a millionaire with your current savings and investments.

Formula:
Years = [ln(Million) - ln(Principal)] ÷ [ln(1 + Annual Return)]
Variables:
  • YearsTime needed to reach $1 million
  • PrincipalInitial investment amount
  • Annual ReturnExpected annual return rate
  • Monthly ContributionsRegular monthly investments
